content.help: Turn off to restore original cubemaps and stop reflection processing and diagnostics. Other options are hidden while disabled. Runtime changes apply when gameplay resumes.

Adjust captured reflections as you move. Enabling this adds GPU work and may reduce FPS while moving. Disable it to reduce the performance cost. Changing this restarts movement history. Off by default.

Enable diagnostic logging and the in-game profiler. Off by default; graph and previews start hidden. Ctrl+F6 shows/hides the graph; Ctrl+F7 selects GPU/CPU; Ctrl+F10 shows/hides cubemap previews. With previews shown, Ctrl+F8 selects the preview mip and Ctrl+F9 selects RGB/confidence. Disable diagnostics for normal gameplay and FPS benchmarks. Applies when gameplay resumes.
